title: SAFEST Mobile App
shortDesc: Award-winning safety app for women with secure back-end systems.
longDesc: Led as Team Leader in PKM-KC national competition, spearheading development of SAFEST — a mobile security solution for women. Integrated secure back-end systems with intuitive front-end interfaces. Won Gold Award at CSIT-UPM International iFYP Exhibition & Competition 2026.

title: Image Encryption Website
shortDesc: Web app for encrypting and decrypting images using cryptography algorithms.
longDesc: A cryptography-focused web application that allows users to encrypt and decrypt images. Built with PHP and JavaScript, demonstrating understanding of cryptographic principles and secure data handling.

title: TemuUsaha UI/UX
shortDesc: AI-driven platform UI/UX for micro-entrepreneur work recommendations.
longDesc: Led end-to-end UI/UX design for TemuUsaha, an AI-driven platform empowering micro-entrepreneurs. Designed complex user journeys, high-fidelity prototypes, and smart analytics dashboards. Submitted for GEMASTIK — National Student Competition in ICT (UI/UX category).

title: Text Summarizer R
shortDesc: Research comparing LexRank and LSA extractive summarization algorithms.
longDesc: Research project comparing extractive summarization algorithms: LexRank and Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA). Evaluated accuracy using Jaccard Similarity and ROUGE score metrics. Implemented and tested in R using RStudio.
